regulo.name: label-names-action
regulo.kialo: A person decides from the label alone what happens on activation. A verb says it; a noun or a mood makes them guess.

malobservoj.message: 2 instances with emphasis=high in container pagxo-3 (instances 3, 4).

regulo.name: one-primary-per-container
regulo.kialo: Two equal calls to action move the decision onto the user; one primary action makes the next step obvious, and every other action steps back as secondary or tertiary.
